critical_corrections.reason: Existing Chartres file exact description says Virgin's Veil reliquary; B09 wrong classification fixed in place.

Previous automatic candidate Notre-Dame de Lourdes Statue 01.jpg is explicitly a statue at Cathedral of St Vincent de Paul in Tunis, Tunisia, not Lourdes spring nor Fabisch niche statue. DO NOT reassign.

A separately investigated Commons file, Couronne d'épines ND.jpg, contains a prominent altar cross and windows, not an isolated clear image of the crown despite nominal 3864x5152 pixels; exclude from object-hero shortlist.
2003 Padre Pio tomb is historical, not present-day corporeal relic presentation.

St Charles Milan→Prague Malá Strana interior
Reunion Saint-Leu's La Salette sculpture is not the original Alpine shrine statuary
Guadeloupe Massabielle cave is not Lourdes France

safety_policy: New candidates neither user-approved nor downloaded or published.
Previously KEEP choice covers original preview, not any invented replacement image. New URLs require identity comparison and editorial decision.
Photo license is only uploader declaration and not underlying modern art or Italian heritage clearance.
A photo of a reliquary is not automatically a photo of the relic itself; retain both distinctions.
A historical object photo must not be claimed to show the current shrine state.
Workset of 100 is just the next executable research slice; unsearched targets are not counted as researched or acquired.
No contacting, payments, licence purchases or auto-promotions.
